headline: Colombian Peso Weakens as U.S. Dollar Surpasses 3,400 Threshold
summary: The U.S. dollar exchange rate in Colombia rose to 3,415.10 pesos on Friday morning, gaining 88.14 pesos from the prior level.
why: Fluctuations in the USD/COP rate affect foreign capital inflows, domestic inflation levels, and public sector debt obligations in Colombia.

impacts.name: USD/COP
impacts.why: The U.S. dollar increased by 88.14 pesos against the Colombian peso.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The U.S. dollar surged against the Colombian peso past 3,400 amid global currency shifts.
